tasks.title: Cybernetic Prosthetics
paras: Cybernetic prosthetics have revolutionized medical technology, offering hope to individuals who have lost limbs. Unlike traditional prosthetics, which are often cumbersome and limited in function, cybernetic versions are designed to integrate seamlessly with the human nervous system. This integration allows for more natural movement and even sensation. A key development in this field has been the use of myoelectric sensors, which detect electrical signals generated by muscle movements.

One example is a cybernetic hand that can perform delicate tasks such as picking up small objects or typing. This is achieved through advanced algorithms that translate muscle signals into controlled movements. Researchers are also exploring haptic feedback, which would enable users to feel textures and temperatures through their prosthetic limbs. It involves integrating sensors and actuators that mimic the sensation of touch by stimulating the user's nerve endings or skin with electrical signals. This could significantly improve the quality of life for amputees.

(A)The high cost of these prosthetics makes them inaccessible to many. (B)Additionally, the technology requires regular maintenance and updates, which can be a barrier. (C)Current battery life is another limitation, as it restricts the user's ability to wear the prosthetic for extended periods. Researchers are continually working to make these devices more affordable and user-friendly.(D)

questions.stem: The word "seamlessly" in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：词汇题 原文定位：句中描述技术配合、动作衔接的状态。 正确答案分析：seamlessly 表示 “无缝地、顺畅地、毫无卡顿地”，smoothly（顺畅地、平稳地）含义最接近。 选项分析： (A) generally 通常、大体上 —— 错误，与 “顺畅” 无关。 (B) smoothly 顺畅地、平稳地 —— 正确，与 seamlessly 同义。 (C) repeatedly 反复地 —— 错误，无重复之意。 (D) slowly 缓慢地 —— 错误，意思相反。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about myoelectric sensors?

options.A: They function less effectively in traditional prosthetics.
options.B: They rely less on electric signals than other types of sensors do.
options.C: They allow for more natural movement in cybernetic prosthetics.
options.D: They make cybernetic prosthetics somewhat cumbersome.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：推理题 原文定位：肌电传感器接收肌肉电信号，控制假肢动作。 正确答案分析：肌电传感器能直接读取人体肌肉信号，让假肢动作更贴近真实肢体，因此实现更自然的运动。 选项分析： (A) 在传统假肢中效果更差 —— 错误，文中未对比传统假肢中的效果。 (B) 比其他传感器更少依赖电信号 —— 错误，肌电传感器正是依靠电信号工作。 (C) 使智能假肢能实现更自然的动作 —— 正确，符合肌电传感的核心作用。 (D) 让智能假肢显得笨重 —— 错误，文中无此负面描述。

questions.stem: What does the passage indicate about cybernetic hands?

options.A: They are very similar in appearance to natural human limbs.
options.B: They are currently limited in their range of motion.
options.C: They rely on algorithms that turn muscle signals into movements.
options.D: They can cause skin irritation if worn for extended periods.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：细节题 原文定位：智能机械手通过算法将肌肉电信号转化为具体动作。 正确答案分析：文中明确说明，智能手依靠算法处理肌肉信号并驱动运动，对应选项 C。 选项分析： (A) 外观与真人肢体高度相似 —— 错误，文中未重点强调外观。 (B) 目前活动范围有限 —— 错误，文中未提及活动受限。 (C) 依靠算法将肌肉信号转化为动作 —— 正确，完全对应原文信息。 (D) 长时间佩戴会刺激皮肤 —— 错误，文中未提到皮肤问题。

questions.stem: According to the passage, using haptic feedback in artificial limbs involves each of the following EXCEPT
questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：细节排除题 原文定位：触觉反馈通过传感器、刺激皮肤神经等实现触感。 正确答案分析：文中提到触觉反馈涉及肌电信号检测、刺激神经、使用传感器与驱动器，但完全没有提到改变物体温度。 选项分析： (A) 检测肌肉电信号 —— 正确，属于触觉反馈系统的一部分。 (B) 改变物体的温度 —— 错误，文中未提及，为本题答案。 (C) 刺激皮肤与神经末梢 —— 正确，是触觉反馈的实现方式。 (D) 使用多个传感器和驱动器 —— 正确，原文明确提到。

questions.stem: There are four locations (A, B, C, and D) in the passage that indicate where the following sentence could be added. To take full advantage of these amazing new technologies, a few obstacles need to be overcome. Where would the sentence best fit? Select a location where the sentence could be added to the passage.
questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：句子插入题 正确答案分析：这句话是过渡句，先肯定技术很棒，再引出 “仍有障碍需要克服”。放在位置 A 最合理：前文刚介绍完各项先进技术 插入这句话后，后文顺理成章开始讲挑战、问题或局限性逻辑上是典型的 “优点 → 转折讲不足” 的结构。 选项分析： (A) 正确，承接上文技术优势，引出下文问题。 (B) 插入会打断已有段落逻辑。 (C) 位置偏后，不适合作为总起过渡。 (D) 放在结尾过于突兀，无法引出下文。
